title: Filter account statements by date range

changes.summary: Replaced 'works for any dates' with three Given/When/Then criteria
changes.reason: The original criterion was not testable

user_story.i_want: to list my statements for a date range
user_story.so_that: I can find last quarter's statements without paging through all of them

context: Statements are served by `StatementController.find` at `GET /accounts/{accountId}/statements`, which returns every statement for the account, newest first.

acceptance_criteria.given: account A has statements dated 2026-01-31, 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-31
any account owned by the caller
acceptance_criteria.when: the caller sends a from date later than the to date
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is 400 with error code INVALID_DATE_RANGE

acceptance_criteria.given: account B belongs to another customer
acceptance_criteria.then: the response is 404, the same as without the filter

tech_notes: Filter in the repository query, not in memory.

api_impact.detail: Add optional query parameters from and to (format: date).

out_of_scope: Filtering by amount or statement type

assumptions.text: Either parameter may be sent alone
